open_points.subject: SourceFile.modified
open_points.text: A ready `SourceFile` carries in `modified` the modification time A1 takes from the opened file, so its caller reads no metadata of its own.
open_points.question: Is `modified` present only on a ready `SourceFile`, or also on rejected values for which the opened-file metadata was successfully read, and what value or field presence applies to other rejected values?
options: `modified` is required only for the ready variant and absent on every rejected variant.
`modified` is optional on every `SourceFile` and is populated whenever opened-file metadata was successfully read, including files rejected later.
`modified` is required on every `SourceFile`, requiring a separate rule for rejections before opened-file metadata exists.
open_points.default_guess: Make `modified` optional, populate it whenever opened-file metadata was successfully read, and require it for `ready`.

witness.initial: A named regular file opens successfully and its opened-file metadata is read, but its bytes have an unsupported signature.
events: `module:source_folder` obtains the modification time, reads the bytes and rejects the file under A1 order 6.
outcomes: The rejected `SourceFile` has no `modified` field or has `modified` as null because only ready values carry it.
The rejected `SourceFile` carries the normalized opened-file modification time because A1 obtained it before the later rejection.
witness.observer: `module:photo_delivery` and any model validator or test inspecting the returned `SourceFile`

open_points.subject: public_op:photo_preparation.prepare_photo inputs
open_points.text: The bytes of the source, its modification time (`modified` of the ready `SourceFile` that came with those bytes) and the configured time zone.
open_points.rule: **Вывод импортов из текста — подсказка, а не источник.** Проектор локальной спеки находит кандидатов в импорт по тексту: имя чужого экспорта, встреченное **целым словом** в позитивном тексте notes или в тексте contracts consumer-а, и модели context closure. Каждый такой символ, не объявленный в `module_internal`, отчёт проектора (`python -m tools.slicer report --spec <base spec>`) называет находкой `SLICE_IMPORT_UNDECLARED` (repair_class `spec`): его объявляют в `module_internal` или убирают потребность в нём
open_points.question: Rewrite the input passage without naming the foreign `SourceFile` export, for example by saying that the opened file's modification time is supplied alongside the source bytes; `photo_preparation` does not directly use or import `SourceFile`.
